WHATSAPP_PROFILE.TITLE: My WhatsApp
WHATSAPP_PROFILE.SUBTITLE: Publish status updates and edit the profile of your business number without reaching for the phone.

EMPTY.TITLE: No WhatsApp connection here yet
EMPTY.DESCRIPTION: To publish a status or edit the profile you first need to connect a WhatsApp number under inboxes.

PROFILE.TITLE: Profile
PROFILE.DESCRIPTION: This is what a customer sees when they open the conversation with you.
PROFILE.NAME: Name
PROFILE.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: How your business shows up in the chat
PROFILE.ABOUT_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. open Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm
PROFILE.ABOUT_HINT: WhatsApp does not return the current about text to the dashboard, so this field starts empty and is used to write a new one.

STATUS.TITLE: Status
STATUS.DESCRIPTION: A status goes out to every contact of each chosen number and disappears after 24 hours.
STATUS.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: What do you want to share today
STATUS.CAPTION: Caption
STATUS.VIDEO_HINT: WhatsApp only accepts mp4 for a status, so we convert the file before posting when it comes in another format.

SUGGEST.LABEL: What is the status about
SUGGEST.PLACEHOLDER: e.g. open slots on Saturday for blow-dry

SAVED.PUBLISH: Posting status. Follow the result in the history.

CONFIRM.TITLE: Post this status?
CONFIRM.DESCRIPTION: It goes out to every contact of each chosen number and stays visible for 24 hours, and it cannot be deleted from the dashboard afterwards.

ERRORS.GENERIC: We could not reach WhatsApp right now.
ERRORS.UPLOAD: The file could not be uploaded.
ERRORS.TEXT_REQUIRED: Write the status text before posting.
ERRORS.SCHEDULE_REQUIRED: Pick a future date and time to schedule.

CROPPER.TITLE: Frame the profile picture
CROPPER.DESCRIPTION: WhatsApp shows the picture inside the circle. Drag to move and use the slider to zoom.
CROPPER.HINT: The picture is saved as a 640×640 square.
CROPPER.ERROR: The picture could not be cropped. Try another file.

TEMPLATES.EMPTY: No templates yet. Write a status and save it as a template to reuse it.
TEMPLATES.NAME: Template name

HISTORY.TITLE: History
HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: Drafts, scheduled posts and the result on each connection.
HISTORY.PUBLISH_TARGETS: It goes out to the connections chosen for this status.
